sentences.text: Pending disposal of WP 28971 of 2018, on the file of the High Court.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the memorandum of grounds filed in support thereof and the earlier order of the High Court dated. 17.08.2018 made herein and upon hearing the arguments of Sri Sreemannarayana Vattikuti, Advocate for the Petitioner, GP for IRRI &
CAD for the Respondent Nos.1 to 3, and the Court made the following ORDER At request of learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation and CAD, to obtain instructions from the 3*^'* respondent authority regarding their interference with the possession and enjoyment of the petitioner's land situated in Survey No.353 to an extent of Ac.11.23 cents in Ammaladinne Village, Pedda Pappur Mandal and Ananthapur District, list the matter on 18.03.2026.
JS,J WP.No.28971of 2018

If no instructions are forthcoming from the 3 rd respondent authority,
the 3'^'* respondent shall appear before this Court on that day.
